rules.old_missing: not_reported means source does not publish this field/precision; it does not waive new measurement.
rules.summaries: All three seeds required. Mean of unrounded seed quality values; mean of per-seed ratios; mean of seed latency quantiles. Store total counts separately.

rules.no_claims_from_missing: Missing values, interrupted measurements and disabled diagnostics are distinct; never replace them by zero or historical values.
rules.historical_precision: Keep new raw precision; comparison must respect old published precision and approximate labels.
